title: 第十章 借钱
content_zh:
脚尖在山岩之上轻轻一点，萧薰儿宛如一只紫色蝴蝶一般，曼妙的身姿划起诱人弧线，轻灵的跃上了山顶，微偏着头，目光扫向悬崖边的少年 。
望着少年，薰儿微微一愣，虽然仅仅半天不见，不过她却是觉得，现在的萧炎，似乎比先前，多了点什么
当两双眸子在山风摇拽间相遇之时，薰儿终于是察觉到少年多出了什么，那是自信
时隔三年，昔日少年身上最闪亮的光环，似乎终于再次归来 。
有些迷醉于少年嘴角那若隐若现的笑容，萧薰儿俏美的脸颊，浮现可爱的衅窝，浅笑道：“看萧炎哥哥现在的模样，似乎并不需要薰儿来宽慰了”
“人经历了打击，总得成长不是”萧炎耸了耸肩，笑道 。
“她一定会后悔的。”
熏儿抿着小嘴，轻笑道，信誓旦旦的模样，宛如审判 。
萧炎淡淡一笑，随意理了理衣衫，走向少女 。
走得近了，瞧着已经和自己差不多高的萧熏儿，目光再扫向那张略显稚嫩的美丽小脸，萧炎心头忽然有些恍惚，当年那流着鼻涕，光着屁股跟在后面瞎晃悠的小东西，如今竟然也是出落得这般水灵动人
轻轻的笑了笑，少年目光温醇，手掌毫不客气的在少女惊愕的目光中捏了捏那娇嫩的小脸，笑道：“薰儿也长大了啊，不过还好，没忘记萧炎哥哥小时候为了给你摘果子摔得满身青肿的狼狈样。”
被萧炎的亲昵举动震得愣了好半晌，亮晶晶的灵动眸子盯着那双不含杂质的漆黑眼瞳，熏儿心中轻轻的笑了 。
小时候，他就喜欢捏着自己胖嘟嘟的小脸，可自从三年前的那事后，他便犹如在心灵中竖起了围墙，将所有人都挡在外面，就算自己再如何努力靠近，都会被他那不冷不热的态度刺得黯然离去
“他真的回来了不过，他似乎还是把我当成小时候的跟屁虫，真是根木头”轻轻的撅了撅小嘴，旋即薰儿又有些责怪自己的贪心 。
“薰儿，这三年，可别怪萧炎哥哥，那段时间，我自己都活得浑浑噩噩的，不过还好，有你在身边陪着。”萧炎有点尴尬的捎了捎头，歉意的道 。
熏儿甜甜一笑，三年所受的一些委屈，在少年生涩的道歉声中，顿时烟消云散 。
“咳，对了，熏儿你手上还有多少钱啊”松开手中娇嫩的小脸，萧炎忽然干笑着问道 。
在家族中，除了父亲，便只有薰儿与他关系很好，今天给父亲丢了那么大的面子，他可没脸再去找父亲借钱，所以，也只能把念头打在薰儿身上了 。
“钱”眨巴了一下亮晶晶的大眼睛，熏儿愕然道：“萧炎哥哥需要钱么”
“咳要买点东西，还缺一点。”萧炎小脸有些通红，前身今世，这都是他第一次找女孩子借钱啊 。

头一次看见心中淡然的萧炎哥哥露出这幅窘迫的模样，薰儿顿时有些觉得大开眼界，捂着小嘴娇笑道：“我还有一千多枚金币，够吗如果不够的话”在说着话的同时，熏儿那背在身后的一只纤手上，屈指轻弹，一张紫金色的卡片突兀的出现在了芊芊双指间，卡片之上，闪烁着五道不同颜色的波纹 。
五纹紫金卡，在斗气大陆上，至少需要斗灵的实力，才有资格办理这种代表身份的金卡，当然，一些超然势力，也具备这种资格 。
“够了，够了”欣喜的点了点头，萧炎忍不住的又想去捏熏儿的漂亮脸蛋，不过好在最后硬生生的止了下来 。
“放心吧，等以后我会把钱尽数的还你。”拍了拍胸口，萧炎承喏道 。
“谁稀罕你还呢”小嘴微撇，薰儿背后的紫金卡片，也是被她快速的收了起来 。
“走吧，天晚了，明天我带你去逛逛乌坦城。”萧炎对着少女挥了挥手，率先对着山下兴奋的跳跃而去 。
立在原地，薰儿微笑的盯着那回复了三年前飞扬洒脱的少年，轻轻一笑，低声喃喃道：“纳兰嫣然，我究竟该恨你，还是该谢你”
清晨的阳光从窗户间射将进来，照在床榻之上盘腿修炼的少年身上，暖洋洋的
静坐许久之后，萧炎长长的吸了一口气，一股肉眼可见的淡白气流，顺着口鼻中，灌入了身体之内，温养着骨骼 。
眼眸乍然睁开，眼中白芒掠过，萧炎缓缓的伸了一个懒腰，满脸的迷恋与陶醉：“就是这股感觉，三年了啊，变强的感觉，终于再次回来了。”
慢吞吞的爬下床，活动了一下筋骨，然后换了一身衣衫，门外传来了薰儿那动听的轻灵嗓音：“萧炎哥哥，还没起来”
“这丫头，来得真早。”无奈的摇了摇头，萧炎转身在柜子中翻腾了一会，最后抱出个小匣子，小心翼翼的将之
“这可是我全部的家当了啊。”抱起小匣子，萧炎苦笑着摇了摇头 。
推门走出，望着门口的青春少女，萧炎不由得轻挑的吹了声口哨 。
今天的薰儿，换了一身得体的淡绿色装饰，清淡的颜色，更是使得少女多了几分清纯，一条紧腿长裤将那纤细而修长的美腿包裹得极为圆润，曲线毕露 。
长腿，翘臀，略微发育的小胸脯，现在的薰儿，无疑很象地球上的妙龄少女，充满着活力与诱人的青春气息，当然，不得不说，那股独特的淡雅气质，却是萧炎从未在其他女孩身上见过
“喏，你需要的东西。”瞧着萧炎出来，薰儿笑吟吟的递过来一张黑色卡片，这是普通的存金卡，最大值不能超过五千金币 。
随手接过黑卡，萧炎打趣道：“小妮子穿这么漂亮想干什么难道和别人有约么”
“是啊，是啊，这可是萧炎哥哥三年来第一次邀请我一起出去呢，薰儿可是很受宠若惊哦，当然要打扮得漂亮一点。”萧炎的亲昵取笑，让得薰儿眼眸弯成了浅浅的月牙，俏皮的娇笑道 。
无奈的摇了摇头，心情大好的萧炎，也是笑着回了几句，两人笑谈着对着家族之外行去，半路上，也遇见了一些族中的族人，在瞧得他与薰儿亲昵谈笑的模样之后，都是不由面露奇异之色 。

现在的薰儿，无论是美貌还是天赋，都是家族中年轻一辈最耀眼的明珠，平日在家族中，虽然看似温雅和气，不过在那淡淡的微笑之下，却是蕴含着一股隐晦的冷漠，和她打个招呼，容易，想要深聊，很难 。
没有理会这些族人的神色，萧炎领着薰儿，直接出了家族，然后放慢了速度，悠闲的在人来人往的大街之上游荡着
乌坦城不愧是加玛帝国的大型城市之一，人气极为盛况，虽然现在是炎炎烈日，可大街之上，人流依然汹涌，甚至还能偶尔看见一些奇异的种族 。
或许是由于萧炎的陪伴，出了家族后，薰儿变得活泼了许多，拉着无奈的萧炎，不断的在各处摊贩前乱窜，少女轻灵的娇笑声，让得处在炎热暴晒之下的街道，清凉了几分 。
在薰儿玩倦之后，萧炎这才带着她寻了附近的药材店，花了九百多枚金币，买下了三支二十年份的紫叶兰草以及两株五年份的洗骨花，这些都是低级材料，只要花些钱，便能够在药材店中买到，当然，如果还想需要更高级的材料，那便只能自己去寻找，或者去坊市，拍卖会等地方了 。
望着手中急速缩水的财产，萧炎苦笑着摇了摇头，现在，他终于明白了钱在斗气大陆，有多重要了
药材已经到手，唯一还缺的，便是一枚一级的木系魔核了
content_en:
With her toes lightly tapping on the rock, Xiao Xun'er was like a purple butterfly. Her graceful figure drew a seductive arc, and she jumped up to the top of the mountain. She tilted her head slightly and glanced at the young man on the edge of the cliff.
Looking at the young man, Xun'er was slightly startled. Although she had not seen him for only half a day, she felt that Xiao Yan seemed to have something more than before.
When the two pairs of eyes met in the swaying mountain wind, Xun'er finally noticed something extra in the boy, which was confidence.
After three years, the brightest aura of the former boy seems to have finally returned again.
Somewhat fascinated by the looming smile at the corner of the young man's mouth, Xiao Xun'er's pretty cheeks showed a cute crinkle, and said with a smile: "Looking at brother Xiao Yan's current appearance, it seems that Xun'er doesn't need Xun'er to comfort him anymore."
"People have to grow after experiencing a blow," Xiao Yan shrugged and said with a smile.
"She will regret it."
Xun'er pursed her small mouth and smiled softly, her sworn look like a judgment.
Xiao Yan smiled faintly, straightened his clothes casually, and walked towards the girl.
As he got closer, he looked at Xiao Xun'er, who was almost as tall as him, and glanced at that beautiful, slightly childish face. Xiao Yan suddenly felt a little confused. The little thing with a runny nose and a naked butt that followed behind him was now so charming.
Smiling softly, the young man's eyes were warm, and he pinched the young girl's delicate face unceremoniously in the astonished gaze with his palms, and said with a smile: "Xun'er has grown up too, but fortunately, I haven't forgotten how embarrassing brother Xiao Yan was when he was covered in bruises and bruises trying to pick fruit for you."
Shocked by Xiao Yan's intimate gesture, she was stunned for a long time. Xun'er smiled softly in her heart as her bright, smart eyes stared at those impurity-free dark pupils.
When he was a child, he liked to pinch his chubby little face, but since that incident three years ago, he seemed to have erected a wall in his mind to keep everyone out. No matter how hard he tried to get closer, he would be driven away by his lukewarm attitude.
"He's really back, but he still seems to regard me as a follower when he was a child. What a piece of wood." Xun'er pouted her lips lightly, and soon Xun'er blamed herself for being greedy.
"Xun'er, don't blame brother Xiao Yan for the past three years. During that time, I myself lived in a state of confusion, but luckily, I had you by my side." Xiao Yan tilted his head in embarrassment and said apologetically.
Xun'er smiled sweetly, and some of the grievances she had suffered in the past three years suddenly disappeared in the boy's jerky apology.
"Ahem, by the way, Xun'er, how much money do you still have on hand?" Xiao Yan suddenly asked with a dry smile as he let go of his delicate little face.
In the family, apart from his father, only Xun'er had a good relationship with him. After humiliating his father so much today, he had no shame in asking his father to borrow money again, so he could only focus on Xun'er.
"Qian" blinked his big bright eyes, Xun'er said in astonishment: "Brother Xiao Yan, do you need money?"
"I need to buy something, but I still need a little." Xiao Yan's face turned a little red. This was the first time in his previous life that he asked a girl to borrow money.
Seeing the indifferent brother Xiao Yan look like this for the first time, Xun'er suddenly felt that it was an eye-opener. She covered her mouth and said with a sweet smile: "I still have more than a thousand gold coins, is that enough? If not."
Five-marked Purple Gold Card. In Dou Qi Continent, one needs at least the strength of Dou Ling to be qualified to apply for this gold card that represents identity. Of course, some transcendent forces also have this qualification.
"That's enough, that's enough." Xiao Yan nodded happily, and couldn't help butShe wanted to pinch Xun'er's pretty face again, but fortunately she stopped abruptly in the end.
"Don't worry, I will pay you back all the money later." Xiao Yancheng patted his chest and said.
"Who cares about you?" The little mouth curled slightly, and the purple and gold card behind Xun'er was quickly put away by her.
"Let's go, it's getting late. I'll take you to visit Wutan City tomorrow." Xiao Yan waved to the girl and took the lead in jumping excitedly down the mountain.
Standing on the spot, Xun'er stared at the young man who had regained his free and easy attitude three years ago with a smile. He smiled softly and murmured in a low voice: "Nalan Yanran, should I hate you or thank you?"
The early morning sunlight came in from the window and shone warmly on the young man who was practicing cross-legged on the bed.
After sitting quietly for a long time, Xiao Yan took a long breath. A stream of pale white air visible to the naked eye flowed through his mouth and nose and poured into his body, warming and nourishing his bones.
His eyes suddenly opened, and a white light flashed across them. Xiao Yan stretched slowly, his face full of fascination and intoxication: "This is the feeling. It has been three years. The feeling of becoming stronger is finally back again."
He slowly climbed out of bed, stretched his muscles, and then changed his clothes. Xun'er's beautiful and light voice came from outside the door: "Brother Xiao Yan, you haven't gotten up yet."
"This girl, you came so early." Xiao Yan shook his head helplessly, turned around and rummaged in the cabinet for a while, and finally took out a small box and carefully put it away.
"This is all my belongings." Xiao Yan picked up the small box and shook his head with a wry smile.
Xiao Yan pushed the door open and walked out. Looking at the young girl at the door, Xiao Yan couldn't help but whistle softly.
Today, Xun'er is dressed in a decent light green outfit. The light color makes the girl a little more innocent. A pair of tight-legged trousers wraps her slender and slender legs in an extremely rounded way, revealing her curves.
With long legs, raised hips, and slightly developed breasts, Xun'er now undoubtedly looks like a young girl on earth, full of vitality and attractive youthfulness. Of course, it has to be said that Xiao Yan has never seen that unique and elegant temperament in other girls.
"Here, what you need." Seeing Xiao Yan come out, Xun'er handed over a black card with a smile. This is an ordinary gold deposit card. The maximum value cannot exceed five thousand gold coins.
Taking the black card casually, Xiao Yan joked: "What do you want, little girl, wearing such a beautiful dress? Does she have a date with someone else?"
"Yes, yes, this is the first time that brother Xiao Yan has invited me to go out together in three years. Xun'er is very flattered. Of course, she has to dress up nicely." Xiao Yan's intimate teasing made Xun'er's eyes turn into shallow crescents, and she said with a playful smile.
Helplessly shaking his head, Xiao Yan, who was in a good mood, also smiled and replied a few words. The two of them laughed and chatted towards the outsiders of the clan. On the way, they also met some clan members. After seeing him and Xun'er chatting and laughing intimately, they couldn't help but have strange expressions on their faces.
Today, Xun'er is the most dazzling pearl of the younger generation in the family, both in terms of beauty and talent. Although she looks gentle and gentle in the family, there is a hidden indifference under her faint smile. It is easy to say hello to her, but difficult to have a deep conversation with her.
Ignoring the expressions of these tribesmen, Xiao Yan led Xun'er directly out of the family, then slowed down and wandered leisurely on the crowded streets.
Wutan City is indeed one of the large cities in the Gama Empire, and its popularity is extremely high. Although it is a scorching sun, the flow of people on the street is still turbulent, and you can even see some strange races occasionally.
Perhaps due to Xiao Yan's company, Xun'er became much more lively after leaving the family. She pulled the helpless Xiao Yan and kept running around in front of the vendors, with the girl's light and delicate laughter., making the streets that are under the hot sun a bit cooler.
After Xun'er got tired of playing, Xiao Yan took her to a nearby medicinal shop and spent more than 900 gold coins to buy three 20-year-old purple-leaf orchids and two five-year-old bone-washing flowers. These are low-level materials. You can buy them in medicinal shops for a little money. Of course, if you want more advanced materials, you can only look for them yourself, or go to markets, auctions, and other places.
Looking at the rapidly shrinking property in his hands, Xiao Yan smiled bitterly and shook his head. Now, he finally understood how important money is in Dou Qi Continent.
The medicinal materials have been obtained, and the only thing missing is a first-level wood element magic core.
